video_title: How the Warriors Can SURVIVE without Steph Curry!

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Can the Warriors stay above .500 without Steph Curry?
quotes.excerpt: all they got to do is try to keep this team above 500 until Curry can come back

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: All they got to do is try to keep this team above 500 until Curry can come back. Do they have enough to do that?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: Listen, I think they do. I'm looking at the schedule. Mavs, Grizzlies, Celtics, it might be a little turbulence, Kings, Trail Blazers, it might be a little turbulence, Wizards, Jazz. I think they can get through. Even if they go 500, I think 500 will be an understatement for this group. If they can go out and get six of these, six out of eight of these, I think they can survive until he's back. Especially with that schedule, there's no excuse for them not to be able to get through this next eight.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors roster depth concerns without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: It's just not the same Warriors team we're accustomed to

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: They're now missing Steph, they're missing Porzingis, they're missing Jimmy Butler, Draymond is, it's just not the same Warriors team we're accustomed to. But this schedule, can they get four and four? Sure, but would that change my opinion on this team eight games from now? Probably not. And Steph, with that hip and his age, he ain't going to rush it. He's certainly not going to rush it coming back to this team and this season.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I'm I'm as a 38-year-old superstar averaging close to 30 a game, it's just hard to sit here and be like, yeah, I believe in this group with Steph out. Where is this 30 coming from? Like outside of Yaxel, where is the 30 coming from?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins questions Warriors' scoring depth
quotes.excerpt: I'm not convinced yet. Outside of Yaxel being that offensive talent, I just don't see where most of that scoring comes from.
quotes.quote: I'm not convinced yet. Outside of Yaxel being that offensive talent, I just don't see where most of that scoring comes from. I don't see where that extra 30 comes from. It's going to be tough for the Warriors group. I mean obviously they do have a light schedule on their side which works in their favor but I just don't see where that extra 30 comes from within that group. I just can't see it.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel's reaction to the Spurs loss
quotes.excerpt: We just got the shit beat out of us, I was flustered the entire game.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: His quote after getting beat by the Spurs the way they did, and I quote, 'We just got the shit beat out of us, I was flustered the entire game. I'm not going to move past this. It felt helpless out there.' He also went on to cut his hair, Boogie, cut it all.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I love Yaxel, I love his personality, I love his authenticness, this realness. This is a genuine kid, so I like everything about him. But welcome to the league, you know, this is part of it. It can get like that. And you know, looking at his situation, he's not even in the worst, he's not in the worst situation and he's feeling this way.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins' advice to Yaxel on adversity
quotes.excerpt: My best advice is to, you know, have that next play mentality.
quotes.quote: My best advice is to, you know, have that next play mentality. The only part I don't like is him saying it's going to be hard for me to move past this. You better, because you still got you still got 65 plus games left. So my my best advice, move on, have that next play mentality and just go out there and play your heart out. I mean it's just a rookie learning the learning the league.
